ajuda-perguntas.s: When do I switch to Protection, and when do I get a shield?
Protection from 22, your pick: Redoubt 5/5, with a one-hander and shield.
Two-hander until 21; from 22 a one-hander and shield, with the first Redoubt point.
Other guides advise DPS until 40 and a tank dual spec; you chose 22 instead.
How do I use Judgement now?
Judgement is off the GCD and does not use up the seal: press it whenever it is ready.
With Seal of Fury, Judgement taunts for 3 s at up to 10 yards.
How much should I use Consecration?
It costs a lot of mana: use it in moderation, and hold it when threat is already safe.
Full damage only on the first four enemies.
At 30, rank 2 costs almost double the mana, for a little more damage.
Which seal, aura and blessing do I use while leveling?
Seal of Fury all the time: it is the tank seal from 10.
Retribution Aura is the leveling aura from 16 on.
Blessing of Kings is the leveling blessing for Protection.
What do I do at 12, 20 and 40?
At 12, do the class quest right away, in the Cathedral of Light (Redemption).
At 20, the Tome of Valor gives Bastion of Stormwind, a paladin shield.
At 40, the mount and the dual spec open.
Which weapon and stats should I look for?
The weapon is the biggest jump: spell power and high damage. Rhahk'Zor's Hammer and Scepter of the Abandoned come first.
For Protection, a fast one-hander (1.5 to 1.8 speed) gives more Seal of Fury hits.
For Protection, spell power comes first in the leveling order.
Why does pressing the bubble key twice remove the bubble?
The bubble macro casts Divine Shield and then cancels it, so a second press takes the bubble off.
Pressing it twice in the open world is risky: the bubble is gone.
What helps the tank and warlock duo?
Curse of the Elements from the warlock raises all magic damage, the holy damage of the paladin too.
No source covers the tank and warlock duo as such.
